reasoning_content: Now let's rebuild tex2pdf-service (this time including CHANGELOG.md). Since the bmds addon build is running, I'll queue up the tex2pdf build to run in parallel.

action.command:
cd /workspace && DUMMY_USER=x DUMMY_TOKEN=x PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH" nohup bash -c '
d=/workspace/.build-logs/stage/tex2pdf-service
cd "${d#/workspace/}" 2>/dev/null
rsync -a --exclude .git --exclude .venv /workspace/02-backend/tex2pdf-service/CHANGELOG.md /workspace/.build-logs/stage/tex2pdf-service/CHANGELOG.md
for dep in bizlog decision-protocol ki-logging ki-validierung prompt-loader prompt-security; do
  rsync -a --exclude .git --exclude .venv /workspace/03-shared-services/$dep/ /workspace/.build-logs/stage/tex2pdf-service/$dep/
done
docker run --rm -v /workspace:/w ghcr.io/astral-sh/uv:python3.12-bookworm python3 /w/.build-logs/rewrite_paths.py /w/.build-logs/stage/tex2pdf-service
for pp in $(find /workspace/.build-logs/stage/tex2pdf-service -maxdepth 2 -name pyproject.toml | sort); do
  ( cd "$(dirname $pp)" && timeout 300 uv lock >> /workspace/.build-logs/tex2-relock.log 2>&1 )
done
docker run --rm -v /workspace:/w ghcr.io/astral-sh/uv:python3.12-bookworm python3 /w/.build-logs/patch_dockerfile.py /w/.build-logs/stage/tex2pdf-service
DOCKER_BUILDKIT=1 docker build --secret id=TECHNICAL_USER_USERNAME,env=x --secret id=TECHNICAL_USER_TOKEN,env=x -t tex2pdf-service /workspace/.build-logs/stage/tex2pdf-service >> /workspace/.build-logs/tex2.log 2>&1
echo "$? tex2pdf-service" >> /workspace/.build-logs/tex2-results
' > /workspace/.build-logs/tex2.out 2>&1 & echo "tex2pdf PID $!"; sleep 60; tail -3 /workspace/.build-logs/bmds.log 2>/dev/null; tail -2 /workspace/.build-logs/frontend2.log
